content: {"rules": ["Correct for significant downward bias when model forecasts show monotonic increase while true prices decline.", "Adjust for upward bias when sentiment history is neutral or negative but model predicts steady growth.", "Apply mean-reversion correction when true outcomes oscillate around a lower mean than the forecast trend.", "Reduce forecast values when sentiment drops to zero while model maintains a rising trajectory.", "Account for lag in model response to sudden price spikes by lowering predictions during volatility.", "Correct overshoot errors where model forecasts exceed historical peaks without corresponding sentiment support.", "Apply downward adjustment when sentiment history shows no positive momentum despite rising model forecasts.", "Invert trend corrections when true outcomes show sharp declines contrary to model's gradual increase."]}
